'''Reborn warriors''' are summoned by [[Reborn mage (Daemonheim)|Reborn mages]] to aid them. They can teleport to nearby players, and are able to follow players into nearby rooms. Up to two of them may be summoned by one Reborn mage at any time. If they are not killed, they will eventually die on their own after some time.
